== Card table fill (October 2026) ==

'''Build notes.''' The Destiny and Game text cells of the card tables were filled from each linked card page's <nowiki>{{Card}}</nowiki> fields (<code>destiny=</code>, <code>game_text=</code>), following redirects. Objective rows take the 0-side or 7-side text that matches the row. Only blank cells were filled. Script: <code>vset-fill/fill.py</code> (Datacard Grok); rerun it after card pages change.

'''Marginal cuts.''' Style-guide fixes to the existing text (old, then new):
* <nowiki>== Sources ==</nowiki> → <nowiki>== External links ==</nowiki>
* <nowiki>On 16 September 2009 the Players Committee announced completion of Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV together with a realignment of the existing virtual sets (Virtual Sets 1–18) into thematic Virtual Blocks (contemporaneous secondary sources also summarize this as August 2009).<ref</nowiki> → <nowiki>On 16 September 2009 the Players Committee announced completion of Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV. The same announcement realigned the existing virtual sets (Virtual Sets 1–18) into thematic Virtual Blocks.<ref</nowiki>
* <nowiki>&mdash; secondary encyclopedia note that existing sets were reorganized (often summarized as August 2009; primary PC announce is 16 Sep 2009)</nowiki> → <nowiki>&mdash; summary of the 2009 reorganization of the existing sets</nowiki>

== Set infobox, printed slips, table standard (2026-10-22) ==
Converted to [[Template:Set infobox]] (portrait [[File:Set-VB2-logo.jpg]], symbol [[File:VB2-set-symbol.png]] from a 32x zoom of VirtualBlock2.pdf, code VB2 · GEMP set 601). Tables match [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] / [[Virtual Block 1]]: <code># | Slip | Image | Card | Type | Game text</code>, <code>wikitable</code> with <code>width:auto</code>, nowrap Card and Type. Slip crops are 300 DPI from the official [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf VirtualBlock2.pdf] (official text 7 December 2009; opened Preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf 20261022152656], sha256 6802c315f5a1aed357c2e0e19cd7ac4c0088d5b090ee462c9622f028ec3e63bc). Holotable GIFs stay in Image at 200px. Rarity and destiny stay on the card pages. Dual-face objectives [[Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)]] and [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]] are two rows keyed by slip filename. [[Alert My Star Destroyer! (V)]] and [[Sudden Impact (V)]] both print as 25E on the sheet.
